Everything in Download

VLC is a free and open source cross-platform multimedia player and framework that plays most multimedia files as well as DVDs, Audio CDs, VCDs, and various streaming protocols.

  • Latest OS/2 package (3.0.23) (0B)

Older versions can be found by browsing our archives

Source code

If you want, you can download the source code of VLC media player.

Patches and Bug tracker

Patches needed to compile for the OS/2 platform and a bug tracker are available on the developer's website.
